findings.title: High sustained process CPU and rising RSS during short observation
findings.evidence: CPU 72.5–76.7%; RSS 956–1117 MiB; cgroup peak 1388.5 MiB; RSS rose during the 5min sample
findings.recommendation: Add low-cardinality runtime telemetry for heap/RSS, GC pause and event-loop lag, then profile only in a controlled maintenance window.

findings.title: Health endpoint showed repeated slow responses/timeouts in a bounded probe
findings.classification: confirmed observation, not enough evidence for root cause
findings.evidence: 15 partial samples included two ~5s timeouts and several 3–4.6s responses
findings.recommendation: Investigate event-loop saturation, upstream readiness and proxy timing with existing diagnostics before any optimization.

findings.title: Rollback counter increased substantially
findings.recommendation: Enable approved aggregated statement attribution in a future maintenance change; do not install extensions during this audit.

findings.title: Dead tuples are material in several high-write tables
findings.recommendation: Review autovacuum thresholds and observed activity with DBA-owned metrics; no production setting change made.

findings.title: SSE/client and runtime diagnostics are not externally queryable
findings.evidence: Active clients, queue depth, fan-out, event-loop and GC metrics unavailable
findings.recommendation: Expose bounded sanitized diagnostics through the existing internal system-status boundary, preserving secret and coordinate redaction.

noP0: No critical degradation requiring measurement abort was observed; the audit did not restart or alter production services.
